transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! How are you feeling after your cataract surgery? Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi there! I'm feeling pretty well, thank you. I do have a few questions regarding my recovery. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can start doing light exercise, such as gardening, about 1 week after surgery. Just be sure to wear protective eyewear to avoid any potential risks. And remember to avoid getting water in your eye, especially in the first month after surgery.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You should have started using preservative-free eye drops four times a day to help with dryness after surgery. If you're running out, you can get more from your GP. If you were using eye drops before surgery, such as for dry eyes, it's safe to continue using them unless you've been told otherwise.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's helpful to know, thanks. I'm also wondering, I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
It's normal for the eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as it adjusts to the new lenses. If it's mild and just seems brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses when you're outside should help. But if it's severe or accompanied by pain or redness, we may need to check it further.

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: It's normal for the eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as it adjusts to the new lenses. If it's mild and just seems brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses when you're outside should help.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It's common to have some blurriness in the first week after surgery, but it should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry or getting worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything is okay.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you for all the information!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! I'm glad I could help answer your questions. Now, can you confirm that all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery have been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thanks again for your help!
